advice.good: Mhepo yakanaka. Nakidzwa nekuita zvinhu kunze!

insight.hazardous: Unhu hwemhepo ine ngozi. Gara uri mumba uye shandisa kusefa kwemhepo kana zvichibvira.
about.title: Pamusoro peMframapa AI
about.overview.desc: Mframapa AI inoverenga PM2.5 zuva nezuva munyika 54 dzeAfrica.
about.overview.problem_desc: Maguta akawanda eAfrica haana zvigadzirwa zvekuverenga mhepo. Tinozadza buri iri.
about.how.step1.title: Satellites seSensors
about.how.step1.desc: Kushandisa ESA Sentinel-5P neNASA MERRA-2 satellite data.
about.how.step2.title: Ground Calibration
about.how.step3.title: Continent Inference
about.how.step3.desc: XGBoost model inoverenga PM2.5 pane chero nzvimbo yeAfrica.
about.limit.gap_desc: Kufamba kwesatellite zuva nezuva kunogona kutadza kukwira kwechinguva pfupi.
about.who.citizens_desc: Verenga mhepo usati waita zvinhu kunze.

pwa.core.start_body: Tichadzorera PM2.5 chimiro uye nekuvandudza dashboard yako pfupiso.

pwa.onboarding.step1_body: Tsvaga chero guta reAfrica rinotsigirwa uye uwane PM2.5 mumasekondi.
pwa.onboarding.step2_body: Iyo app inochengeta yako ichangoburwa macheki kune yakaderera-yakabatana mamiriro.
pwa.onboarding.step3_body: Unogona kushandisa bhuku rekusarudza guta uye kudzivirira kugara uchitsvaga nzvimbo.
